meta.face: A Syrian of about sixty with a warm olive complexion and a BROAD-BROWED, SHORT face — a wide, high, domed forehead, a short, straight nose, dark, intent, slightly narrowed eyes under straight black-grey brows, flat, broad cheeks, a wide, firm mouth, a square chin; thick, short, iron-grey hair combed forward; a short, ROUNDED iron-grey beard; a scholar's steady gaze lifted from the page.
meta.basis: The Menologion of Basil II (Wikipedia lead image) shows Lucian in prison with dark, short hair and a short beard in a pale tunic. The book stresses his work on the text of the Scriptures, which gives the codex, pen and scrolls, and his birth at Samosata in Syria; the setting is Antioch, where he taught. The iron-grey colouring for a man martyred in 312 after a long career and the broad-browed structure are our choices, kept apart from `jerome` (long white beard) and `john_damascene` (long, narrow).
